section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.6 | 4.3 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 8.6 | 4.3 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.3 | 5.2 | 750 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
